title: Add YouTube Transcription AI by MrPaloma to writing
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [YouTube Transcription AI by MrPaloma](https://www.mrpaloma.com/trascrivere-video-youtube-pollinations) to writing
- A lightweight, free web app that turns any YouTube video transcript into structured summaries, English translations, and AI-generated concept covers powered by Pollinations.ai. The YouTube Transcript 

Fixes #14688

gist.headline: Videos, distilled into pollen
gist.blurb: MrPaloma’s YouTube Transcription AI has landed in the writing garden. Feed it a YouTube transcript and it turns the long scroll into structured summaries, English translations, and concept-cover ideas.
gist.summary: Added MrPaloma’s lightweight free YouTube Transcription AI to the writing directory, using Pollinations.ai to turn YouTube video transcripts into structured summaries, English translations, and AI-generated concept covers.
gist.impact: People can now discover a ready-to-use web app for converting a YouTube transcript into organized notes, translated text, and visual concept ideas without leaving the Pollinations ecosystem.
gist.visual_concept: Depict MrPaloma’s YouTube transcription tool as a cozy retro writing desk: a small video window sends spoken-word waveform ribbons into a typewriter-like terminal, where they bloom into neatly stacked summary pages, a translation sheet, and a tiny concept-cover canvas. Polli, wearing little editor glasses, guides the ribbons into code-plants; the Monitor Robot can eagerly display a transcript-to-summary transformation. Use a recognizable but non-branded red play-button-like video tile sparingly, while making the transcription, writing, translation, and image-cover workflow the focus.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee with light blue wings, pink cheek blush, black oval eyes, antennae, and a tiny editor’s glasses, hovering beside a retro terminal as a small video tile sends waveform ribbons into transcript pages, an English translation sheet, and a blooming concept-cover canvas; a cheerful CRT Monitor Robot holds a page titled "SUMMARY." Lime green (#ecf874) code-plants and soft mint, lavender, peach, and warm-cream gradients fill the desk garden, with subtle pixel-font text "TRANSCRIBE"; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
